question:
In the given letter-cluster pairs, the first letter-cluster is related to the second letter-cluster following a certain logic. Study the given pairs carefully, and from the given options, select the pair that follows the same logic.

ACR ∶ BDS

GUX ∶ HVY
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

ACR ∶ BDS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/344a2da8e6c040e872c3cc17c8da994abff957affdbccdf8dbf33f06d9657a41.png] 

GUX ∶ HVY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80b3a511e9c4b45ebf022f69e21a65799e83acc06510d64bb5c90615840f0d87.png] 

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) OIF ∶ NHE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a53f3ebfd90c9a5579f9542b897923cbfc1a26594e6fb746eb57380a5c0abdcf.png] 

Option 2) MQF ∶ NRG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b876f4f0f70f0c3dedc79a9bfb72a01765c323e44d3862fdfd626ec9241a89f.png] 

Option 3) SIO ∶ KQP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/362d6e1993903bfe8e8d995cd4fb110db47240ea1aca124d93f388f5e2a44ff8.png] 

Option 4) HJL ∶ SQO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccc1bfcf2878747624a94458250e2fdbb5b3c72566afc49e7f385c095f4fe3ff.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'MQF ∶ NRG' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
